# neo-value-types spec delta -- neo-callvirt-clr-struct-arg

## ADDED

### Requirement: An autogenerated Neo redirect for a CLR method taking a by-value value-type parameter MUST read the parameter via ReadNeoValueType

Under `ENABLE_NEO_MODE`, an autogenerated Neo redirect delegate (`*_Neo` stub,
registered on `RedirectMapNeo`) for a CLR method (generic-instance or otherwise)
that takes a value-type parameter BY VALUE (canonical case:
`List<TestVector3>.Add(TestVector3 item)`) MUST read that parameter from the
callee param region (`__frameBase`) via
`ILIntepreter.ReadNeoValueType(typeof(T), __frameBase, ref __curPrim,
GetNeoValueTypeManagedSize(typeof(T)))` -- the SAME helper + size source
(`Unsafe.SizeOf<T>`) the reflection fallback (`CLRMethod.Invoke(byte*)`) and
the post-Step-13b generator (`BindingGeneratorExtensions.AppendArgumentCodeNeo`)
use. The cursor (`__curPrim`) MUST have been advanced past the `this` slot (via
`ReadNeoReference` for a reference-type `this`, or the appropriate VT-`this`
read) before the value-type param read.

Rationale: the JIT call-lowering + `CopyNeoCallArguments` + the `NeoCallParamMap`
already size the callee param slot by the struct's flat managed size
(`PrimitiveSize[i] = GetNeoValueTypeManagedSize`) and copy the caller's struct
bytes into it. A stub that leaves the param as `default(T)` with a `// TODO`
(the pre-Step-13b autogen emission) therefore delivers a ZERO struct to the host
CLR method, regardless of the caller having constructed + marshalled the struct
correctly. The generator (`AppendArgumentCodeNeo`) was fixed in Step-13b / child-
28 to emit `ReadNeoValueType` for a by-value struct param (with-or-without a
registered ValueTypeBinder, pure-primitive case); a committed stub predating that
fix is a stale stub and MUST be hand-ported to the same template (full regen is
GUI-bound). The Legacy (`#else`) stub is unaffected.

NOTE: this covers the IL->CLR struct-arg direction (a `call`/`callvirt.clr` to a
CLR method). The reverse direction -- a CLR host invoking an IL delegate/lambda
that takes or returns a value type (e.g. `Enumerable.Sum(list, v => v.X)` where
the host calls the `FunctionDelegateAdapter` with a struct arg / reads a float
return) -- is a Step-19 delegate marshalling concern, NOT covered here.
